EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Termination (WO)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
We received a message that you have questions about employee terminations. If your Time & Attendance system interfaces with Insperity Payroll, any terminations that are processed in Payroll will transfer over into the system in the nightly interface. The employee will then automatically disappear from your list once you have closed the period in which their stop date exists.
If your Time & Attendance system doesn't interface with Insperity Payroll, or if you would like to process the termination prior to the information coming over from Payroll, you can utilize the instructions on this page in the Help Center, which details how to terminate an employee manually.
Please let us know if you have any further questions and we'll be happy to help.
Thank you,
